title: antennaria neglecta var. neodioica
intro: Antennaria neglecta var. neodioica, commonly known as Mountain Silvermoss, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family, native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to aid in digestion, relieve inflammation, and soothe respiratory issues due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Silvermoss include its antiviral, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are used to combat infections and inflammation.
